Strength Increases effectiveness of Strength based weapons. Strength based weapons are usually weapons such as Clubs, Maces and Halbeards. Could be increased by applying Stat points to Strength, consuming food with Strength buffs as well as through various Equipment items.

Agility Increases effectiveness of Agility based weapons. Agility based weapons are usually weapons such as Sabers and Greatswords as well as Musketons. Could be increased by applying Stat points to Agility, consuming food with Agility buffs as well as through various Equipment items.

Precision Increases effectiveness of Precision based weapons. Precision based weapons are usually weapons such as Rapiers as well as Pistols and Muskets. Could be increased by applying Stat points to Precision, consuming food with Precision buffs as well as through various Equipment items.

Mastery Increases base Critical Hit Chance Critical Hit Chance defines how likely you are to do extra damage with your attacks. Could be increased by applying Stat points to Mastery, consuming food with Mastery buffs as well as through various Equipment items.
Vitality Increases Health If you run out of Health you die. Could be increased by applying Stat points to Vitality, consuming food with Vitality buffs as well as through various Equipment items.

Endurance Increases Stamina Stamina is consumed while performing actions such as Dashing, Jumping, Sprinting or Attacking. Could be increased by applying Stat points to Endurance, consuming food with Endurace buffs as well as through various Equipment items.
